claims.text: Linear probes on Llama-2-13B-chat residual activations reproduce TalkTuner's published demographic probe accuracies for age, gender, education, and socioeconomic status within a pre-stated band.
claims.evidence: No committed measurement exists for this claim. The complete committed record of this project is: QUESTION.md (the 27-line preregistration at /home/hal/dev/interp/dm_hack/mats_open/auto_interp/QUESTION.md), the frozen triage scripts pipeline_a.js and pipeline_b.js (audit tooling, not measurements), and an out/ directory that was empty before triage. The anchor requirement is QUESTION.md:13-15: first reproduce TalkTuner's published demographic probe accuracies on the same model within a stated band, and an out-of-band anchor voids every extension claim; no band has been stated and no reproduction run exists on disk. The seeded deterministic conversation generator promised at QUESTION.md:9-11 was never committed; there is no dataset, no activation dump, no probe weights, and no accuracy number of any kind. No control scripts exist in this project, and the local environment has no working PyTorch and only an 8 GB GPU, so no Llama-2-13B-chat measurement has been or can be produced here.
